recipes.name: Vegan Gado Gado with Sun-Dried Tomatoes
instructions: Heat the oil in a sauté pan over high heat. Cook the onion and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the mock chicken pieces. Continue to cook until lightly golden, about 5 minutes. Then transfer to a bowl.
Add the green beans and boiling water to the now-empty pan. Cover with a lid and cook at a gentle simmer for 7 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the rice according to the package instructions.
Add all the ingredients for the peanut sauce to a small food processor and blend until smooth*.
Add the bell pepper to the pan with green beans. Cover and cook for 5 more minutes. A bit of remaining water is fine, but drain any excess beyond 1- 2 Tbsp.
Add the onion and mock chicken mixture back into the pan, along with the sun-dried tomatoes, soy sauce, and sambal. Cook until heated through.
Serve with rice, top with the peanut sauce, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes * Alternatively, mix all of the ingredients in a bowl, with the garlic crushed in.
Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 4 days.
